steps.cmd:
./target/debug/notes-api > server.log 2>&1 &
pid=$!
timeout 20 sh -c 'until grep -q "listening on" server.log; do sleep 0.1; done'
curl -s -w '\n' -X POST localhost:3000/notes -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"text":"survives a restart"}'
kill -TERM $pid
wait $pid; echo "exit status: $?"
cat server.log
steps.out:
{"id":1,"text":"survives a restart"}
exit status: 0
 INFO notes_api: listening on addr=127.0.0.1:3000
 INFO notes_api::http: note created id=1
 INFO notes_api: shutdown signal received
 INFO notes_api: stopped
